validity.researcher_notes:
TWO spec concerns for P5535 (Line II), combined into one validity record because validity[] keys on (segment_name, concern_type) and both are 'spec':

(a) DIAMETER -- CONFIRMED CORRECTION (higher confidence): the sheet's Diameter=1020mm is very likely wrong for this row. Two independent sources agree Line II is 1220mm: OSM community tagging, consistent across all 6 constituent ways of the Line-2 relation (17713721, e.g. way 377314744, name:en='Gryazovets - Leningrad 2'); and an independent Leningrad-Oblast highway-reconstruction project document (eurostolica.ru) naming 'Gryazovets-Leningrad-1' Du1000 and 'Gryazovets-Leningrad-2' Du1200 as two separate, differently-sized lines. GEM's OWN routes-repo geojson for P5535 (way 377314744) already carries diameter='1220 mm' from this same OSM source -- so the sheet cell disagrees with GEM's own already-ingested route geometry, a pre-existing internal inconsistency. By contrast, relation 17713722 ('Line 1' / P5534)'s ways consistently tag 1020mm, matching the sheet's P5534 value exactly -- confirming this is specifically a Line-2 sheet error, not a general OSM tagging quirk. Recommend changing Diameter to 1220mm for P5535 only.

(b) STARTYEAR1 -- FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED (lower confidence, no safe replacement): StartYear1=1991 is contradicted by Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta's own company history (https://web.archive.org/web/20150512013501/http://ukhta-tr.gazprom.ru/about/history/), which states both lines ('dve nitki') of the Gryazovets-Leningrad system were already built by 21 August 1986 (Severgazprom's formation date) -- five years before 1991. The most specific date found (a Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta VK anniversary post, cp1251-decoded, 31 October 1979) is diameter-tagged 1020mm, identifying it as Line I (P5534)'s commissioning date, not this row's corrected 1220mm Line II -- so it cannot safely be reused here without misattributing a Line-I fact to Line II. No source pins an exact commissioning year specific to Line II; it is only bounded to a pre-1986 window (and, if after Line I, post-1979). Not proposing a specific replacement year, since that would be fabricated precision this evidence doesn't support -- flagging as a concern for a human reviewer / follow-up search instead.
